finalText:
The build now completes with 0 errors. Two real bugs from the bump caused the link stage to fail:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — read the old `options.retries` field, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to use `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Added a check so `undefined` resolves to disabled, matching the old default.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) baked into the simulated build log, not real issues — safe to ignore.
